What does an apartment Google Business Profile management company do?

Short answer

An apartment Google Business Profile management company keeps each community's Google profile complete, active and accurate, and answers every Google review in the property's voice, while the management company stays the owner of the profile. The SocialDM is an apartment Google Business Profile management company. Through its LocalLift program it posts fresh local updates, replies to every review, keeps the profile in step with the website, and reports calls, direction requests and website clicks every week. It markets more than 7,900 apartment homes across the country, and at Huxley Scottsdale we took over marketing at 52% leased and it was 88% leased by November 2026.

The problem

What an apartment Google Business Profile management company should handle

01Fresh posts. Regular, local Google posts that show the community, the homes and the neighborhood, so the profile looks active to renters and to AI search.
02Every review answered. A prompt, thoughtful reply to every Google review, positive or negative, written in the community's voice, with anything that needs onsite details flagged to your team first.
03Accurate facts. Hours, amenities, pricing and specials on the profile kept in step with the website and listing sites, so renters and AI tools see the same thing everywhere.
04Rules compliance. Posts checked against Google's current posting rules before they go live, which helps keep the profile in good standing.
05Clear ownership. Your company stays the primary owner of the profile and adds the provider as a Manager that can be removed at any time.
06Weekly reporting. Calls, direction requests and website clicks from Google, reported every week so you can see what the profile drives.
What it costs youRenters often see your Google profile before your website. A stale profile or unanswered reviews can cost you the tour.

LocalLift Site Read keeps your profile and website in step. The LocalLift Weekly Pulse reports calls, direction requests and website clicks every week. Every package is priced per property, so a single community gets the same work as a full portfolio.

FAQ

Questions we hear

What does an apartment Google Business Profile management company do?

It keeps each community's Google profile complete, active and accurate, posts regular local updates, answers every Google review in the property's voice, and reports what the profile drives, such as calls, direction requests and website clicks. Your company stays the owner of the profile.

Is The SocialDM an apartment Google Business Profile management company?

Yes. The SocialDM manages Google Business Profiles and review replies for apartment communities through its LocalLift program, for single communities and full portfolios.

Do we give up ownership of our Google profile?

No. Your company stays the primary owner and adds The SocialDM as a Manager. You keep full control and can remove access at any time.

Can we hire you for just one apartment community?

Yes. Every package is priced per property, so a single community gets the same LocalLift work as our largest portfolios.

Does Google profile management help with ChatGPT and AI search?

It can. AI tools tend to draw on Google profiles and reviews when they describe a community, so a complete, current profile with answered reviews gives them more accurate things to say.
